title_en: Essay: A Day in the Future
note_en: 把 moves the object in front of the verb when something happens to it: 智能管家把奶奶叫醒 "the smart assistant wakes Grandma up"; (机器人)把药送到她手里 "(the robot) puts the medicine right into her hand." After the verb there's usually a result or direction (醒, 到…手里). 把 is handy when what matters is what happened to the object, not just who did what.
